AbilityAcquisitionDispatch: The player stands at the statue: input masked, 6 ticks (WaitByte #05), LookupAbilityForm decides the form. Will ability: Freedan / Shadow -> Transform_FreedanToWill. Freedan ability: Will -> Transform_WillToFreedanAlt, Shadow -> Transform_ShadowToFreedan, Freedan -> nothing. Then it waits for playerFlags $0800 to clear, grants the ability, flies the orb to the player, plays the fanfare and the two texts, restores the music and unmasks.
AbilityOrbActor: Ability orb: finds the ability bit for $0B12 in AbilitySceneTable (table position = ability index in globalScriptIndex), dies if the bit is already in abilityBitmask, otherwise shows the orb (animation #0A) and waits for the player at the statue zone (3,A)-(5,B).
AbilitySceneTable: 6 entries (scene, abilityBitmask bit): $15 -> $01 Psycho Dash, $62 -> $02 Psycho Slider, $86 -> $04 Spin Dash, $42 -> $10 Dark Friar, $A7 -> $20 Aura Barrier, $B8 -> $40 Earthquaker, then two $00 bytes (the end marker and one more). Low nibble = Will, high nibble = Freedan. Bit $08 is not used.
AuraItemGrant: Not referenced: gives item $24 (or AuraItemInventoryFull), flies the item to the player, music track $17 and the 'You have the Aura!' text.
AuraItemInteraction: Not referenced (only spawned by DS_AuraItemRoom): an Aura item pickup at the Shadow statue. Dies if the player has item $24, otherwise waits at zone (B,A)-(D,B).
AuraItemInventoryFull: Not referenced: 'Your inventory is full' text.
AuraItemWaitLoop: Wait loop of the unreferenced Aura pickup.
code_08CED6: Reward threshold cascade — checks each tier in ascending order
code_list_08D7E2: Layout jump table by variant: 0 DS_LayoutBasic, 1 DS_LayoutTransform, 2 DS_LayoutAbility, 3 DS_LayoutSpecial.
code_list_08D888: Room jump table by characterForm: 0 DS_WillTransformRoom, 1 DS_FreedanTransformRoom, 2 DS_ShadowTransformRoom.
code_list_08DB56: Hint handlers by position in GaiaHintSceneTable (34 entries, $00-$21).
code_list_08DBAB: Save prompt table: 0 cancel and 2 = GaiaThenGo, 1 = GaiaSaveConfirm.
code_list_08DBD4: Continue prompt table: 1 (Yes) = GaiaThenGo ('Then go.'), 2 (No) and 0 (cancel) = GaiaThenRest ('Then rest a while.').
dark_space: Dao variant of the portal (one spawn, scene_C3_actors): saves the spawn variant and uses the OAM attribute word $3000 (sprite priority 3). The stub then branches into DarkSpacePortalInit.
dark_space2: Standard portal (31 spawns): same as dark_space with the OAM attribute word $2000 (sprite priority 2). It has no branch: execution falls through into DarkSpacePortalInit.
DarkSpaceAmbientParticle: Not referenced: an actor that only sets the display-filter bit ($1000 in $12). FireflyParticle does the same itself.
DarkSpaceButtonCheck: Needs Up ($0800) in the raw joypad word (BranchIfPressed with mask bit 0 set reads joypadRaw) to start the warp.
DarkSpaceDaoEntry: dark_space entry stub: $24 := $0E (spawn parameter >> 1 = Gaia room variant 0 to 2), $0E := $3000 (OAM attribute word, priority 3), then BRA DarkSpacePortalInit.
DarkSpaceExit: Leaves the Dark Space: masks input, hides the player, plays the dissolve at his spot, waits 30 ticks (WaitByte #1D) and fills the warp words from $0B12 / $0B08 / $0B0C / $0B10 (see the block note). The scene change itself is done by the warp words and the next frame's transition.
DarkSpaceInteractionMonitor: Hidden child (flags $2300) that watches for the entry. SetEntryHere is placed before two NOPs, so every frame it restarts at the NOPs. Does nothing while displayModeFlags bit $0080 (display-filter actor mode) is set; otherwise tests the player's tile offset from the portal and calls DarkSpaceButtonCheck when he is on the entry tiles.
DarkSpaceMainInit: Entry. Spawns the firefly spawner, the Gaia sprite (128, 64) and the voice sparkle (128, 88), validates the room variant in $0AAC (0 to 3, else 0), keeps it in $0AB2, clears $0AAC and switch-cases to the layout.
DarkSpaceMonitorEntryTest: Entry test: BranchIfPlayerInRelTiles ( minX -1, minY 0, maxX 1, maxY 1 ): the player is inside when -1 < dx <= 1 and 0 < dy <= 1 tiles relative to the portal; the branch goes to DarkSpaceButtonCheck.
DarkSpaceMonitorStartWarp: Entry sequence, run by the monitor (see the block note): mask the joypad, hide the player, play animation #1C (the warp effect) at the player's spot and wait 30 ticks (WaitByte #1D) after it ends, snap the player onto the portal (one tile north in the warp-test position), set the transition words, layerPriorityFlag $0200 and the variant in globalScriptIndex. The scene change itself comes from the E6 warp rectangle. It never restores the mask or the player's hidden bit: the scene change resets them.
DarkSpacePortalClose: Player left: closing animation #21 once, then back to the closed frame (DarkSpacePortalClosed).
DarkSpacePortalClosed: Closed state: stage the closed frame #24 (also the target when the portal has finished closing).
DarkSpacePortalClosedLoop: Closed loop: one frame per pass while the player is not within 5 tiles; BranchIfPlayerNear ( #05 ) leaves to DarkSpacePortalOpen.
DarkSpacePortalInit: Common init of both variants and of the four direct spawners (which set $24 first). Sets Flags12 $0004, the metasprite and the closed frame #24, makes the tile solid, clears the hidden bit $2000, sets Flags10 $0B00 and extendedFlags $0200 (radar dot) and spawns DarkSpaceInteractionMonitor (flags $2300), giving it the variant in its $24. Then runs the closed-state loop.
DarkSpacePortalOpen: Player came near: play the opening animation #1F once (AnimOnce), then show the open frame #20 and enter the open loop. The first test (Flags10 bit $4000, the off-screen flag) branches to the very next instruction, so it has no effect.
DarkSpacePortalOpenAnim: Opening animation #1F (AnimOnce), then the open frame #20; continues into the open loop at DarkSpacePortalOpenLoop.
DarkSpacePortalOpenIdle: Open idle loop: one frame per pass, then back to the proximity test at DarkSpacePortalOpenLoop.
DarkSpacePortalOpenLoop: Open loop test: still within 5 tiles continues in DarkSpacePortalOpenIdle, otherwise falls through to the closing animation (DarkSpacePortalClose). The opening animation is not interrupted: the test runs only after AnimOnce has ended.
DarkSpaceRestoreControl: Called at the end of every transformation (JSR, X = player): player entry back to PlayerIdleEntry, movement chains and $08 cleared, $10 bit 9 cleared and bit 3 set, D-pad unmasked ($0F00), playerFlags $0800 cleared.
DarkSpaceStandardEntry: dark_space2 entry stub: $24 := $0E (spawn parameter >> 1), $0E := $2000, then falls through into DarkSpacePortalInit.
dialogstring_08DE96: Shared prefix of most hints ('I am Gaia, the source of all life. I'll give you some advice.'), pulled in with [PRT:].
dialogstring_08E066: Not referenced: Gold Ship door hint (gold tiles, melody of the Incan spirit).
dialogstring_08E0C7: Not referenced: hint about an untouchable enemy and Edward Castle.
dialogstring_08E109: Not referenced: hint about the wall where the wind blows.
dialogstring_08E19C: Not referenced: Diamond Mine keys hint.
dialogstring_08E615: Not referenced: Pyramid six blocks hint.
dialogstring_08EB68: '[ability name] can now be used!' (name from table_08EB8F by $0AAC through [ADR:]).
dialogstring_08EB85: Description of the ability (table_08EBD3 by $0AAC through [ADR:]).
DS_AbilityTalkGaia: Gaia dialogue and back to the wait state. The code after its BRA (loc_08DA6B, loc_08DA77) is not reachable.
DS_AbilityTileWait: Yield of the ability wait state, followed by loc_08DA52 (active state).
DS_AuraItemRoom: Not referenced: alternate room with BG changes $8B, $8F, $89, $8A and an AuraItemInteraction actor at ($C0, $78); zones Gaia, left statue (to Shadow) and exit. Layout 3 reaches the Aura item through GaiaHint_AuraItem instead.
DS_AuraTileWait: Yield of the Aura wait state, followed by loc_08DAC9.
DS_BasicTalkGaia: Calls GaiaDialogueEntry, then goes back to the wait state.
DS_BasicWait: Wait state of layout 0 (RTL, re-run every frame) followed by loc_08D863, the active state: Gaia zone = DS_BasicTalkGaia, exit zone = DarkSpaceExit.
DS_FreedanInputWait: Wait state of the Freedan room.
DS_FreedanRevertWill: Left statue: WillRevertDialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_FreedanTalkGaia: Gaia dialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_FreedanTileWait: Yield of the Freedan wait state, followed by loc_08D931 (active state).
DS_FreedanToShadow: Right statue: ShadowTransformDialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_FreedanTransformRoom: Room for Freedan: BG changes $87 and $8A, plus $8E and $8F when event flag $B4 is set. Left statue = back to Will, right statue = Shadow.
DS_LayoutAbility: Layout 2: BG change $8A, then a search of AbilitySceneTable for $0B12. Found: a Will ability (low nibble) shows BG $86 and spawns AbilityOrbActor at (64,109) with orbitAngle = 0; a Freedan ability shows BG $8B and the orb at (64,84) with orbitAngle = 1. Not found: no orb. Then the Gaia and exit zones.
DS_LayoutBasic: Layout 0: Gaia statue only. Waits while the player stands on the Gaia zone, then handles the Gaia and exit zones.
DS_LayoutSpecial: Layout 3: sets $0AAC = 1 and jumps to layout 1. The flag survives (the init cleared it before the dispatch), so GaiaHint_AuraItem later sees a non-zero value.
DS_LayoutTransform: Layout 1 (and 3): switch-case on characterForm to the room of the current form.
DS_ShadowRevertWill: Left statue: WillRevertDialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_ShadowTalkGaia: Gaia dialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_ShadowTileWait: Yield of the Shadow wait state, followed by loc_08D997 (active state).
DS_ShadowToFreedan: Right statue: FreedanTransformDialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_ShadowTransformRoom: Room for Shadow: BG changes $87, $8A, $8D and $8F unconditionally (flag $B4 is necessarily set). Left statue = back to Will, right statue = Freedan. The wait and active states are loc_08D97A and loc_08D997 (the room label itself is the set-up).
DS_WillInputWait: Wait state of the Will room: nothing happens while the player stands in any of the three zones.
DS_WillTalkGaia: Gaia dialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_WillTileWait: Yield (RTL) of the Will wait state, followed by loc_08D8C5 (active state).
DS_WillToFreedan: Left statue: FreedanTransformDialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_WillToShadow: Right statue: ShadowTransformDialogue, then back to the wait state.
DS_WillTransformRoom: Room for Will: BG changes $88 and $8A, plus $8E and $8F when event flag $B4 is set (the Shadow statue). Zones: Gaia (7,8)-(9,9), left statue (3,A)-(5,B) = Freedan, right statue (B,A)-(D,B) = Shadow, exit (5,D)-(B,F). What the BG changes draw was not decoded (OQ-I056-3).
FireflyParticle: One firefly: display-filtered, spriteset_pickups_effects animation #02, starts at Y = 0 and a random X (RNG x 2), movement chains 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 on X and one less on Y, removed when Y reaches $FF. The loop would end at once for a negative Y step, so it must move down; the old note said it rises (OQ-I056-2).
FireflySpawnerLoop: Ambient loop: sets the $08 timer to a random 0 to 120 (RNG & $0F, x 8; the wait lasts timer + 1 ticks), spawns one FireflyParticle, then yields until the timer is done; repeats forever.
FreedanTransformAccept: Will -> Transform_WillToFreedanAlt, Shadow -> Transform_ShadowToFreedan (loc_08F105); sets $0800 and returns to the room.
FreedanTransformDecline: Clears the dialogue box and returns.
FreedanTransformDialogue: Left statue of Will / Shadow rooms. Already Freedan = return. First visit (flag $F7): lore text, then Transform_WillToFreedan (the standing version; it assumes the player is Will). Later visits: 'Change into the Dark Knight, Freedan?' (FreedanTransformPrompt).
FreedanTransformPrompt: Yes / No prompt, cursor on No.
GaiaDialogueEntry: Gaia talk: 6-tick pause (WaitByte #05) with input masked, voice sparkle on, intro text on the first visit (event flag $DC), then GaiaHealAndHints.
GaiaHealAndHints: HP check and heal (hpToHeal = 40, one HP per 8 frames until full), then the hint lookup by source scene; falls to the save prompt when the scene has no entry.
GaiaHint_AnkorWat: Scene $BB (Ankor Wat top floor): the temple text.
GaiaHint_AuraDesc: The player already has the Aura: description text only.
GaiaHint_AuraFull: Inventory full: 'Cut down on your inventory and come back.'
GaiaHint_AuraItem: Scene $CC (Pyramid): when $0AAC is non-zero (layout 3): gives item $24 (the Aura) unless the player has it (GaiaHint_AuraDesc) or the inventory is full (GaiaHint_AuraFull): text, fanfare (track $18, then 90 ticks: WaitByte #59), 'You have the Aura!', waits for the SPC reply $FF, back to track $16, the Aura description, then the save prompt. With $0AAC = 0 it is just the save prompt.
GaiaHint_CastlianBoss: Scene $1E (Larai Cliff): warning about a huge enemy whose head shoots rays of light when hurt.
GaiaHint_CometApproach: Scene $E3 (Babel Tower): the last talk with Gaia.
GaiaHint_Jewels: Scene $0B (Edward Prison): jewel and Start-map hint.
GaiaHint_MuContinent: Scene $60 (Mu): Mu rising from the sea.
GaiaHint_SouthCape01: Scene $01 (South Cape): no hint text, save prompt only.
GaiaHintSceneTable: 34 source scene IDs ($01, $0B, $15, $1E, $26, $28, $34, $3D, $40, $42, $4C, $51, $54, $56, $5A, $60, $62, $6C, $7C, $85, $86, $99, $A1, $A3, $A7, $AC, $B6, $B8, $BB, $C3, $CC, $E0, $E3, $12) then two $00 bytes (the end marker the search stops at, and one more); the position is the GaiaHint_xx index.
GaiaNpcSprite: Gaia: animation #00 of spm_darkspace_sprites (frames 100, 13, 13 and 13 ticks) played once per run; the script has no SetEntryHere, so it re-enters from the start and the animation repeats.
GaiaSaveConfirm: Record: SaveGameState_Scene for slot $0D8C, SFX $29, 60 ticks (WaitByte #3B), then 'Continue your journey?' (Yes = entry 1).
GaiaSavePrompt: Save prompt, shared end of every hint handler: unmask input, 'Record what's happened so far?' with Record / Don't record.
GaiaThenGo: 'Then go.': voice sparkle off and return to the room loop. Reached by 'Don't record', by cancelling the save prompt and by 'Yes' to 'Continue your journey?'.
GaiaThenRest: 'Then rest a while.' (No to 'Continue your journey?'): voice sparkle off, input masked, the player hidden, dissolve animation $1C at his spot, fade to track $0E and yield forever.
GaiaVoiceSparkle: Voice effect: $24 is the switch (set to $FFFF by the dialogue routines, 0 otherwise). While on and an SFX is queued on channel 1 it shows a random sparkle frame: #01 (RNG 0 or 3), #02 (1) or #03 (2).
JewelerCancelReply: Reply for cancel and for 'Just wanted to see you': a short farewell text, then the talk ends.
JewelerCheck50: 50-jewel tier: no 'given' flag, so with 50 or more jewels every talk warps to scene $E9 and never reaches the menu below.
JewelerCountJewels: BCD jewel counting: count the item #01 entries of the 16 inventory slots in the absolute scratch word $0000, add the count to jewelsCollected in decimal mode, remove every jewel and re-run the tier check.
JewelerDie: Flag $E8 (set by sEA_solid_arm; the old note said 'game complete'): Gem leaves the scene.
JewelerGiveJewelsOption: 'Give you Red Jewels': continue at JewelerCountJewels if the inventory holds an item #01, otherwise say there are none and end the talk.
JewelerGoodbye_unused: Unreferenced: prints 'Well, see ya. Somewhere.' and returns. Dead code.
JewelerInteract: Talk entry (the chatPtr): greeting, the jewel count if non-zero, then the tier cascade starting at code_08CED6.
JewelerInventoryFull: Target of the Herb GiveItem failure branch: prints 'Your inventory seems to be full' and ends the talk (the flag stays clear, so the next talk retries).
JewelerMenuTable: DialogueOptions result table: index 0 = B cancel, 1 = 'Just wanted to see you', 2 = 'Give you Red Jewels', 3 = 'See your inventory'.
JewelerRewardDarkFriar: Reward: 30 jewels -> Dark Friar upgrade level $0B1C = 2, flag $EE.
JewelerRewardHp: Reward: 8 jewels -> max HP + 1 and hpToHeal = 1 (one HP restored), flag $EB.
JewelerRewardPsychoDash: Reward: 20 jewels -> Psycho Dash upgrade level $0B16 = 1, flag $ED.
JewelerSecretRoom: Reward: 50 jewels -> queue a map change to scene $E9 (sE9_mansion_intro, the entrance to the optional Solid Arm fight). No flag is set.
JewelerShowInventory: "See your inventory" — display reward list with completion markers
loc_08D7D3: The variant is valid or was forced to 0: store it in $0AB2 and clear $0AAC; the variant also goes to $0000 for the SwitchCase.
loc_08D863: Active state of layout 0 (SetEntryHere + zone tests).
loc_08D8C5: Active state of the Will room: Gaia = DS_WillTalkGaia, left statue = DS_WillToFreedan, right statue = DS_WillToShadow, exit = DarkSpaceExit.
loc_08D931: Active state of the Freedan room: Gaia, left statue = WillRevertDialogue, right statue = ShadowTransformDialogue, exit.
loc_08D97A: Wait state of the Shadow room (the loop target of every Shadow handler).
loc_08D997: Active state of the Shadow room: Gaia, left statue = WillRevertDialogue, right statue = FreedanTransformDialogue, exit.
loc_08D9D5: Table search loop: 2-byte entries, X steps by 2, a zero scene byte ends the table.
loc_08D9E7: Scene found: read the ability bit, restore X (PLX) and branch on the low nibble.
loc_08DA1C: Freedan-ability branch: BG $8B, orb at (64,84), orbitAngle = 1.
loc_08DA44: Scene not in the table: restore X and continue without an orb.
loc_08DA45: Wait state of the ability room (SetEntryHere, zone test).
loc_08DA52: Active state of the ability room: Gaia = DS_AbilityTalkGaia, exit = DarkSpaceExit. The statue zone belongs to the orb actor.
loc_08DA6B: Not referenced: would call WillRevertDialogue or FreedanTransformDialogue by orbitAngle (a statue interaction that moved into AbilityOrbActor).
loc_08DA77: Not referenced: the FreedanTransformDialogue half of loc_08DA6B.
loc_08DAB4: Wait state of the unreferenced Aura room.
loc_08DAC9: Active state of the unreferenced Aura room.
loc_08DB37: HP is full or healed: start the hint table search (X is saved with PHX).
loc_08DB3B: Hint table search loop: 1-byte entries, a zero ends the table.
loc_08DB4C: Scene found: X = hint index, restore X and switch-case to the GaiaHint_xx handler.
loc_08DB9A: Scene not in the hint table: restore X and fall into the save prompt.
loc_08DCAF: $0AAC is non-zero: the Aura gift sequence.
loc_08DCDF: The fanfare has finished (APUIO1 = $FF): restart the room music (track $16), print the Aura description and go to the save prompt.
loc_08E9DB: Table search loop (Y counts the entries).
loc_08E9EE: Scene not found or ability already known: restore X and Die.
loc_08E9F1: Scene found: keep the ability bit in $24, die if it is already in abilityBitmask, store the entry index in $0AAC.
loc_08EA38: Shadow -> Freedan: write Transform_ShadowToFreedan into the player entry and set $0800.
loc_08EA58: Will -> Freedan: write Transform_WillToFreedanAlt into the player entry and set $0800.
loc_08EA78: Will ability: if the player is not Will, write Transform_FreedanToWill (also used from the Shadow form) and set $0800.
loc_08EA9B: Wait for the transformation to finish (playerFlags $0800 clear).
loc_08EAAA: Ability grant sequence: 8-frame pause, abilityBitmask |= $24, orb animation, orb flies to (player X, Y - 16), fanfare, 'X can now be used!', wait for the SPC, description text, music back to track $16, unmask, Die.
loc_08EB0D: The fanfare has finished: voice sparkle on, description text (table_08EBD3 by $0AAC), voice sparkle off.
loc_08EB45: Scene found: test the high nibble ($F0).
loc_08EB57: Scene not found: restore X and return with carry set.
loc_08EFAD: Unreferenced pickup: voice sparkle on, description, voice sparkle off, unmask.
loc_08F2E6: The player is not Will: pause 6 ticks (WaitByte #05), show the prompt.
loc_08F436: Write Transform_WillToShadow into the player entry, set $0800, return.
loc_08F456: Write Transform_FreedanToShadow into the player entry, set $0800, return.
loc_08F6C4: Per-frame loop: reload the move chains, animate, repeat while Y < $FF.
loc_09A09E: Wait / test loop: yield, return unless $24 is set and sfxQueueCh1 is non-zero.
loc_09A0C1: Sparkle variant #02: show one frame and return to the test loop.
loc_09A0CC: Sparkle variant #03: show one frame and return to the test loop.
LookupAbilityForm: Searches AbilitySceneTable for $0B12 and returns A = 0 when the ability bit is in the low nibble (Will), 1 when it is in the high nibble (Freedan); carry set if the scene is missing (the only caller ignores it). It was first called LookupStatueType after the old 'statue type' reading (there is no statue type).
ShadowTransformDecline: Clears the dialogue box and returns.
ShadowTransformDialogue: Right statue. Locked (return) when event flag $B4 is clear or the player is already Shadow. First visit (flag $DD): lore text, then the transformation without a prompt (Will: WillToShadow at loc_08F436, Freedan: FreedanToShadow at loc_08F456). Later: 'Change to the ultimate Dark warrior, Shadow?'.
ShadowTransformPrompt: Yes / No prompt, cursor on No.
table_08EB8F: Ability names by ability index (table position in AbilitySceneTable).
Transform_FreedanToShadow: Freedan -> Shadow: frames 7, 9, 8 (SFX $25), palette thinker (bundle ID $6C), frames $0E, $0F, spawns ShadowShimmerInit, characterForm = 2, frames $10, $12, DarkSpaceRestoreControl.
Transform_FreedanToWill: Freedan -> Will: frames 6, 9, 8 (SFX $25 after the first), characterForm = 0, one-frame yield, palette thinker (bundle ID $0B), frames 3, 2, 5, DarkSpaceRestoreControl. Entered from 6 other files.
Transform_ShadowToFreedan: Shadow -> Freedan: frames $0D, $10, $0F, $0E, characterForm = 1, one-frame yield, palette thinker (bundle ID $0C), frames 8, 9, $0B, DarkSpaceRestoreControl.
Transform_ShadowToWill: Shadow -> Will: frames $0D, $10, $0F, $0E, characterForm = 0, one-frame yield, palette thinker (bundle ID $0B), frames 3, 2, 5, DarkSpaceRestoreControl. Entered from 6 other files.
Transform_WillToFreedan: Will -> Freedan, standing version (first-visit lore): player body #05 frame 0, SFX $25 on both channels, animation 2 x 2 passes, 3 x 2 passes, palette thinker (bundle ID $0C), animations 8 and 9 x 2 passes, frame $0A, characterForm = 1, DarkSpaceRestoreControl.
Transform_WillToFreedanAlt: Will -> Freedan, frame version: frames 1, 2, 3, palette thinker (bundle ID $0C), frames 8, 9, $0B, characterForm = 1, DarkSpaceRestoreControl. Entered from the prompt and from the ability orb.
Transform_WillToShadow: Will -> Shadow: frames 0, 2, 3 (SFX $25), palette thinker (bundle ID $6C), frames $0E, $0F, spawns ShadowShimmerInit, characterForm = 2, frames $10, $12, DarkSpaceRestoreControl. Entered from 7 other files (boss and ending scripts).
WillRevertAccept: Freedan -> Transform_FreedanToWill, Shadow -> Transform_ShadowToWill (loc_08F331); sets $0800 and returns.
WillRevertDecline: Clears the dialogue box and returns.
WillRevertDialogue: Left statue of Freedan / Shadow rooms. Already Will = return. Otherwise 'Return to young Will?' (cursor on Yes).
